title: A2 listening check
goal: Show that you can understand voicemails, short stories, announcements and a weather report, including Canadian speakers, and catch the main point and key details.

items.note: In Québec, often shortened to le dép. In France: une supérette, une épicerie.

example.fr: Je vais au dépanneur acheter du lait.
example.en: I'm going to the convenience store to buy milk.

example.fr: Le train part de la voie 6.

items.fr: avec un retard de vingt minutes

blocks.title: A2 listening: what you can do
blocks.body:
At A2, a listener can understand **phrases and common words** about familiar topics (family, work, shopping, the neighbourhood, appointments) and catch the **main point of short, clear messages and announcements**.

This check has **14 items**. In each recording, **one person speaks**: a friend's voicemail, a clinic, a short story, a station announcement, a radio weather report.

- **Part 1:** voicemails and short stories (7 items)
- **Part 2:** announcements, radio and public messages (7 items)

For 3 items, you type exactly what you hear. Several speakers use **Canadian French** words, such as [[souper]], [[fin de semaine]], [[dépanneur]] or [[tuque]]. Aim for **80%** (12 of 14) to pass the checkpoint.

**For a fair score:** read the question and the options *before* you play the audio, and play each recording **no more than twice**. In TEF and TCF Canada, recordings are usually played **only once**, so practise catching the key words the first time: numbers, days, times, and words like [[mais]], [[malheureusement]], [[au lieu de]].

steps.title: Part 1: Voicemails and stories
steps.intro: Each recording is one person speaking. Listen for who, what, when and why.

blocks.fr: Salut Mei, c'est Lucie ! Je t'appelle pour la fin de semaine. Samedi, on fait un souper chez nous pour l'anniversaire de Karim. Tu peux apporter un dessert ? On commence vers 18 h 30. Rappelle-moi !
blocks.en: Hi Mei, it's Lucie! I'm calling about the weekend. On Saturday, we're having a supper at our place for Karim's birthday. Can you bring a dessert? We're starting around 6:30. Call me back!
blocks.prompt: What does Lucie ask Mei to do?
options: Bring a dessert to a birthday supper on Saturday
Make supper for Karim on Sunday
Buy a birthday present for Karim
blocks.explain: [[Tu peux apporter un dessert ?]] In Québec, [[le souper]] is the evening meal and [[la fin de semaine]] is the weekend (in France, [[le dîner]] and [[le week-end]]).

blocks.fr: Bonjour Monsieur Patel, ici la clinique médicale Saint-Laurent. Votre rendez-vous de jeudi à 10 h avec la docteure Lavoie est annulé, parce qu'elle est malade. Nous pouvons vous proposer vendredi à 14 h 15. Merci de nous rappeler au 613 555-0110.
blocks.en: Hello Mr. Patel, this is the Saint-Laurent medical clinic. Your appointment on Thursday at 10 a.m. with Dr. Lavoie is cancelled, because she is sick. We can offer you Friday at 2:15 p.m. Please call us back at 613-555-0110.
blocks.prompt: What does the clinic offer Mr. Patel?
options: A new appointment on Friday at 2:15 p.m.
The same appointment with another doctor on Thursday
A new appointment on Thursday at 2:15 p.m.
blocks.explain: Thursday 10 h is [[annulé]] (cancelled). The new offer is [[vendredi à 14 h 15]], 2:15 p.m.

blocks.fr: La semaine dernière, j'ai eu une drôle de journée. Je suis partie de chez moi à 8 h, comme d'habitude. Il neigeait beaucoup et l'autobus n'est pas venu, alors j'ai marché jusqu'au métro. Quand je suis enfin arrivée au bureau, il n'y avait personne. C'était un jour férié : le bureau était fermé !
blocks.en: Last week, I had a strange day. I left home at 8, as usual. It was snowing a lot and the bus didn't come, so I walked to the metro. When I finally got to the office, there was nobody there. It was a public holiday: the office was closed!
options: It was a public holiday and the office was closed
Everyone was stuck in the snow
She arrived too late in the evening
blocks.explain: [[C'était un jour férié : le bureau était fermé !]] = it was a public holiday, the office was closed. The snow and the bus are the background of the story, not the reason the office was empty.

blocks.fr: Salut Raj, c'est Olivier. Je suis au dépanneur, en face du bureau. Tu veux un café ? Ils ont aussi des muffins. Envoie-moi un texto, je reviens dans cinq minutes.
blocks.en: Hi Raj, it's Olivier. I'm at the convenience store across from the office. Do you want a coffee? They also have muffins. Send me a text, I'll be back in five minutes.
blocks.prompt: Where is Olivier, and what does he want Raj to do?
options: At the convenience store; send him a text
At a café downtown; call him back
At the bakery; come and meet him
blocks.explain: [[Le dépanneur]] is the Québec word for a corner convenience store. [[Envoie-moi un texto]] = send me a text.

blocks.fr: Je suis arrivée à Montréal il y a trois ans.
accept: Je suis arrivé à Montréal il y a trois ans.
Je suis arrivée à Montréal il y a 3 ans.
Je suis arrivé à Montréal il y a 3 ans.
blocks.explain: [[Arriver]] takes être: [[je suis arrivée]] (a woman speaking). [[Il y a trois ans]] = three years ago.

blocks.fr: L'été prochain, je ne partirai pas en voyage. Je vais rester à Gatineau, parce que je commencerai un nouveau travail en juin. Mais en septembre, j'irai voir mes parents au Maroc pendant deux semaines.
blocks.en: Next summer, I won't go on a trip. I'm going to stay in Gatineau, because I'll start a new job in June. But in September, I'll go and see my parents in Morocco for two weeks.
blocks.prompt: When will the speaker visit their parents?
options: In September, for two weeks
In June, before the new job
Next summer, for the whole summer
blocks.explain: [[En septembre, j'irai voir mes parents… pendant deux semaines]]. In June the speaker starts a new job ([[je commencerai]]), and stays in Gatineau next summer.

blocks.fr: Bonjour Madame Reyes, ici le magasin Sport Plus. Vos bottes sont arrivées, mais malheureusement, elles sont en pointure 38, et pas en 39. Vous pouvez les échanger ou être remboursée. Passez au magasin avant samedi avec votre facture.
blocks.en: Hello Ms. Reyes, this is the Sport Plus store. Your boots have arrived, but unfortunately they're a size 38, not 39. You can exchange them or get a refund. Come to the store before Saturday with your receipt.
blocks.prompt: What is the problem with Ms. Reyes's boots?
options: They are the wrong size
They haven't arrived yet
They are more expensive than planned
blocks.explain: [[Malheureusement, elles sont en pointure 38, et pas en 39]]. [[La pointure]] is the size for shoes and boots. She can [[échanger]] (exchange) them or [[être remboursée]] (get a refund).

steps.title: Part 2: Announcements and radio
steps.intro: Public messages are faster and more formal. Catch the key information: what's happening, where, and what to do.

blocks.fr: Votre attention, s'il vous plaît. En raison d'un problème technique, le service est interrompu sur la ligne orange, entre les stations Berri-UQAM et Jean-Talon. Des autobus remplacent le métro. Le service devrait reprendre vers 17 h.
blocks.en: Your attention, please. Because of a technical problem, service is interrupted on the orange line, between Berri-UQAM and Jean-Talon stations. Buses are replacing the metro. Service should resume around 5 p.m.
blocks.prompt: How can passengers travel between Berri-UQAM and Jean-Talon now?
options: By bus: buses are replacing the metro
By metro, with a 5-minute delay
On the green line
blocks.explain: [[Des autobus remplacent le métro]] = buses are replacing the metro. [[En raison de]] = because of; [[le service devrait reprendre vers 17 h]] = should resume around 5 p.m.

blocks.fr: Mesdames et messieurs, le train numéro 24 à destination de Québec partira avec un retard d'environ vingt minutes. Le départ est maintenant prévu à 15 h 40, voie 6. Merci de votre compréhension.
blocks.en: Ladies and gentlemen, train number 24 to Québec City will leave about twenty minutes late. Departure is now scheduled for 3:40 p.m., track 6. Thank you for your understanding.
blocks.prompt: When and where does the train to Québec City leave?
options: At 3:40 p.m., from track 6
At 3:20 p.m., from track 6
At 3:40 p.m., from track 24
blocks.explain: [[Le départ est maintenant prévu à 15 h 40, voie 6]]. 24 is the train number. The old time was about 15 h 20, before the delay.

blocks.fr: Bonjour à tous ! Aujourd'hui à Montréal, ce sera nuageux le matin, puis il neigera en après-midi : on attend dix centimètres. Il fera moins huit, mais avec le vent, on aura l'impression qu'il fait moins quinze. Sortez vos tuques et vos mitaines !
blocks.en: Hello everyone! Today in Montréal, it will be cloudy in the morning, then it will snow in the afternoon: we're expecting ten centimetres. It will be minus eight, but with the wind it will feel like minus fifteen. Get out your toques and mittens!
blocks.prompt: What will the weather be like this afternoon?
options: Snow, about 10 cm, and it will feel like minus 15
Cloudy and minus 8, with no snow
Rain, then 10 cm of snow in the evening
blocks.explain: [[Il neigera en après-midi : on attend dix centimètres]]. The real temperature is minus 8, but with the wind it feels like minus 15. [[Tuques]] and [[mitaines]] are the Québec words for winter hats and mittens.

blocks.fr: Vous êtes nouveau au Canada ? La bibliothèque du quartier organise une soirée d'information gratuite sur la recherche d'emploi, le mercredi 12 mars à 19 h. Vous pourrez rencontrer des conseillers et préparer votre CV. Attention : l'inscription est obligatoire, au comptoir ou par téléphone.
blocks.en: Are you new to Canada? The neighbourhood library is organizing a free information evening about job searching, on Wednesday, March 12 at 7 p.m. You'll be able to meet advisers and prepare your résumé. Note: registration is required, at the desk or by phone.
blocks.prompt: What must you do to attend the evening?
options: Register in advance, at the desk or by phone
Pay at the door
Send your résumé before March 12
blocks.explain: [[L'inscription est obligatoire]] = registration is required. The evening is [[gratuite]] (free), and you prepare your résumé **there**.

blocks.fr: Il faisait très froid quand je suis sortie ce matin.
accept: Il faisait très froid quand je suis sorti ce matin.
blocks.explain: Background in the imparfait ([[il faisait]]), event in the passé composé ([[je suis sortie]]). [[Sortir]] takes être.

blocks.fr: Chers clients, notre magasin fermera dans quinze minutes. Merci de vous diriger vers les caisses. Et n'oubliez pas : cette fin de semaine, tous les manteaux d'hiver sont à moitié prix !
blocks.en: Dear customers, our store will close in fifteen minutes. Please make your way to the checkouts. And don't forget: this weekend, all winter coats are half price!
blocks.prompt: What special offer does the store announce?
options: Half-price winter coats this weekend
Fifteen percent off everything tonight
Free winter coats for new customers
blocks.explain: [[Cette fin de semaine, tous les manteaux d'hiver sont à moitié prix]]. [[Dans quinze minutes]] is when the store closes, not a discount.
[[Pourriez-vous]] + [[me rappeler]]: a polite request. [[Rappeler]] has two p's and one l.

summary:
- Catch the key details in voicemails: changed appointments, invitations, problems with an order
- Follow a short story in the past and find the main point
- Understand station, metro and store announcements and a weather report, including Canadian words like [[souper]], [[dépanneur]], [[tuque]] and [[fin de semaine]]

meta.author: ai
meta.notes: Made l3 answerable without the untaught word férié (added le bureau était fermé). Reworded l8 so its answer does not depend on devrait reprendre. Prompts now use only names heard in the audio and no longer assume the speaker's gender. Added digit variants to the l5 dictation.
